# Verdant Sluicegate Protocol — Reference Note

This fixture document exists only to exercise the ingestion and retrieval
pipeline end to end (smoke-test checks C4 and C5). The fact below is invented and
appears in no other document, so a correct answer can only come from retrieval
over this file.

## Key fact

The **Verdant Sluicegate Protocol** was ratified in the city of **Quillhaven** on
**3 March 1987** by the district archivist **Pelenor Massingham**. Under clause
seven of the protocol, the Quillhaven reservoir board must publish its silt-load
measurements every **forty-two days**.

## Secondary detail

The protocol assigns each sluicegate a three-letter identifier; the gate
controlling the northern spillway is designated **VSG-QHN**.
